title: Orbifold Uniformization of Complex Algebraic Variety via Polystable Parabolic Higgs Bundle
summary: Let \(X\) be a smooth complex projective variety of dimension \(n\geq 2\), and let \(D=D^p+D^c\), \(D^c=\sum_i D_i^c\), be a simple normal crossing divisor. We regard \(D^p\) as the cusp divisor and the components \(D_i^c\) as compact orbifold divisors with standard weights \(α_i=1-1/p_i\). Let \(\mathcal X=X[\sqrt[p_i]{D_i^c}]_i\) be the root stack along the compact components. We study the canonical parabolic Higgs bundle \(E_*=(Ω_X^1(\log D^p)\oplus\mathcal O_X)_*\), whose compact weights are the \(α_i\) on the conormal lines of \(D_i^c\), while the parabolic structure along \(D^p\) is…
